facts.fact: The African Union Commission's status list updated 2 February 2026 shows Eritrea with no date of signature, ratification/accession or deposit for the Malabo Convention (21 signatures and 20 ratifications among 55 states).
facts.system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection

note: States only that Eritrea has no comprehensive data protection law or regulator; names no shared African text.

facts.fact: tralac states that, of the 55 AU member states, only Eritrea has yet to sign the consolidated text of the AfCFTA Agreement, which it says covers digital trade among other matters; 49 countries had signed and deposited ratification by July 2026. The page gives no date for the statement beyond its 'last updated: July 2026', so the published month is used.
